source.title: Data-Driven Intelligent Analysis System for Monitoring and Anomaly Detection in Hydrogen Refueling Station
source.data_availability_statement: Original contributions are included in the article; further inquiries are directed to the authors.

claim_boundary: The publication provides article-level field HRS context and semi-synthetic anomaly-detection methodology, but no rights-cleared raw time series or independently reproducible station logs are committed here. It may support explanations of data-quality checks, anomaly classes and monitoring architecture; it must not be used to calibrate this station's thresholds, claim independent accuracy, or validate station-to-vehicle behavior.
